[[Eye of the North]] }} [[File:Dungeon Key GUI info.jpg|Info that appears in the [[User interface|UI]] after pickup.|thumb|right]] The [[Dungeon Key]] is an item found in the dungeons of Eye of the North. When a player fulfils a certain requirement, usually killing a boss in a dungeon, a key will appear on the ground. The key is color matched to its own door. You need to use a key on a Dungeon Lock near to door. ==Locations== *[[Depths of Tyria]] **[[Arachni's Haunt]] ***Level 1: [[Spider Matriarch]] **[[Bloodstone Caves]] ***Level 1: [[Paranoia Ettin]] ***Level 2: [[Crystal Ettin]] **[[Catacombs of Kathandrax]] ***Level 1: [[Infernal Siege Wurm]] ***Level 2: [[Regent of Flame]] **[[Cathedral of Flames]] ***Level 1: [[Faze Magekiller]] ***Level 2: [[Tyndir Flamecaller]] ***Level 3: [[Keymaster of Murakai]] **[[Darkrime Delves]] ***Level 1: On the ground **[[Forsaken Tunnels]] ***Level 1: [[Wyle Brimscourge]] **[[Oola's Lab]] ***Level 1: [[Xien]] ***Level 2: [[Malfunctioning Enduring Golem]] **[[Raven's Point]] ***Level 1: [[Reaper of Destruction]] ***Level 2: On the ground **[[Rragar's Menagerie]] ***Level 1: [[Rragar Maneater]] ***Level 2: On the ground **[[Secret Lair of the Snowmen]] ***[[Angry Snowman]] **[[Shards of Orr]] ***Levels 1, 2, and 3: [[Cursed Brigand]] **[[Slavers' Exile]] ***Selvetarm's level: On the ground ***Forgewight's Level: [[Dark Watcher]] **[[Vloxen Excavations]] ***Level 2: [[Taskmaster Bellok]] ==Notes== *Although you can't pick a key up while your inventory is full, it will not take up a space in your inventory. In such case you can drop any item from inventory, take a key and then pick up an item back. *Once a dungeon key is acquired, the words "Dungeon Key retrieved" and a blue dungeon key icon will appear on the left side of the UI's Mission Goals overlay. *See also: [[Boss Key]] {{anomaly|The message ''Dungeon Key retrieved'' and the image of the key cannot be switched off even if you have cleared all the interface options on the Options pane (F11).}}
